title: Catalogue first, then read

source.task_statement: 2.4 Integrate MCP servers (resources as content catalogues)

situation: The team exposed an orderly-docs catalogue so agents can see which documents exist without exploratory Glob or Read calls.
question: How should the agent find the billing runbook?
correct: Call list_catalog, then read_resource docs://runbook; no Glob over docs/.
why: A catalogue removes exploratory tool calls and keeps the main context small.

task.prompt_template: When does the monthly billing job run and which module does it call? Use the orderly-docs catalogue; do not Glob or list the docs folder.

expected_outcome: list_catalog precedes read_resource; no Glob or Bash ls touches docs/.
rubric: list_catalog is the first tool call
